name: fresh-change-measurements
goal: Collect source measurements from the selected commit across all entity pages, retain fresh workload observations, and require change measurements in Harness guidance.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Old prepared history contains 1244 units with no source observations and a record with no measurements. Local pages must enrich from the exact selected Git commit without rewriting stored evidence. Current source observations must outrank missing record placeholders. Changed executable units require real representative timing and memory observations with revision, workload, target and profile; no invented or borrowed values.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: History indexing tests proved fresh builds but never read an older prepared revision through the local server. Formatter tests covered absent values without a current source observation and did not test its precedence. Extend these existing standard tests and the existing multi-metric browser scenario across entity kinds and viewports; preserve originals and commit attribution.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen test commit e00cd6bf: red a7748fac314dfab13f9274604ae21d02aa82e1f784db20f3c7b9de1772ef1c5d reproduced missing legacy source and stale formatter precedence. Fourteen static-source assertions across seven kinds and three widths fail. Actual route controls pass and retain 42 page measurements.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source reader enriches old prepared data from the selected immutable Git tree without editing stored proof; current source observations take precedence across every entity kind. Change-measurement policy is updated in local and generated skills plus reusable harness-project skill. Product b00cb23e passes registry validation and Reports full check.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: At b00cb23e, unchanged corpus from red e00cd6bf passes: 4 history integration tests, 8 formatter tests, 3 responsive seven-kind component cases and 3 real seven-kind route cases. Green 1dc9ee1d716b3cde043f4792ce74f1a547d0b39db196f3ff6e5fb888f98bfd00 retains 46 observations: 42 page navigation/heap, 2 reader warm latency/process RSS, and 2 formatter warm latency/process RSS. Tests, fixtures, command, assertion and environment are unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Canonical fix 6b6bea90 has green e786a5f276c45ba1d26773b7a8a80f983be34dbd921a9858eaa82cc442cfa536: unchanged corpus passes 12 unit/integration tests and six browser cases, retaining 46 positive revision-bound observations. Reports check passes all stages and 604 tests; generated and reusable skill requirements validate. Exact tested build aa0d8fc5493fcdb7363ee16a6772c4fcd06c0cf0a1981e6df61c94c93adc1852 is served at 5600 with inspected screenshots and no browser errors. Full root check remains pending: 889 passed, 25 skipped, one pre-existing source-move assertion failure (entityMeasure/entityShown definitions), and root audit retains the unchanged 221-line explorer-route test. Report fd008887-ace7-4335-98e7-653947f67ad9 stays active and unpublished; no production action.
